name: Yardi Breeze
positioning: Yardi's accounting rigour, stripped of the implementation project that Voyager requires.
description: Yardi Breeze and Breeze Premier are the self-service tier of Yardi's platform, aimed at small and mid-sized managers across residential, commercial, affordable and self-storage portfolios. Setup is guided rather than consultant-led, and pricing is published per unit with a monthly minimum.
real_estate_use: Chosen by managers who want Yardi's accounting model — property-level ledgers, owner draws, CAM reconciliation in the Premier tier — without a six-month Voyager implementation. It is also the natural landing point for firms that expect to grow into Voyager later and want the data model to be familiar.
features: Property accounting with owner payments and reporting
Online applications, leases and rent collection
Maintenance requests and vendor work orders
Commercial features including CAM reconciliation in Premier

use_cases.job: Get real property accounting without a consultant-led implementation
Manage a mixed residential and small commercial portfolio in one ledger
